channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: AI model finds simple counterexample to 87-year-old math conjecture
item.description: A mathematician at Anthropic used the AI model Claude Fable 5 to discover a compact counterexample that disproves the Jacobian conjecture, a longstanding problem.

item.title: Ancient fossils from 567 million years ago reshape understanding of early animal life
item.description: A fossil site in Canada reveals 567-million-year-old creatures that may be among the earliest to move and reproduce sexually, offering new insights into animal evolution.

item.title: Brain cells identified that sustain motivation during challenging tasks
item.description: Orexin neurons appear to help maintain effort when rewards become harder to obtain. Blocking their activity may reduce persistence.

item.title: Fossilized snake brain reveals unexpected diversity in early species
item.description: A well-preserved snake fossil from Brazil shows that early snakes were more varied than previously believed. Detailed brain reconstruction offers new insights.
